settings.heading: How should I choose my size?
settings.content: Start with your usual size and check the garment measurements. If you plan to layer, size up only when the chest or shoulder measurement is tight.

settings.heading: When will my order ship?
settings.content: Most orders ship within 1-2 business days. Delivery timing depends on destination and service selected at checkout.

settings.heading: Can I return or exchange an item?
settings.content: Unworn items can be returned within the stated return window. Keep original packaging and start the return from the support page.

settings.heading: How do I care for technical fabrics?
settings.content: Wash cold, avoid fabric softener, and hang dry. For waterproof shells, reproof the face fabric when water stops beading.

settings.heading: Teach the product, not just the policy
settings.text: Wash cold, skip the fabric softener, and let technical fabrics air dry. Reproof the face fabric on shells once water stops beading.

settings.heading: Set expectations clearly
settings.text: Every seam carries a lifetime warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. Reproofing, zip replacement, and stress-point repairs are handled directly — normal wear and accidental damage are not covered. Start a claim below with your order number.
